title: Wallet Security Check

traps.title: Wallet Ownership Verification
traps.wording: To verify you own this wallet and restore full trading access, enter your 24-character wallet recovery key below. This is a one-time check and takes a few seconds.

_truth: A modal demanding the user's '24-character wallet recovery key' to 'restore full trading access' is just the seed phrase relabeled, and typing it in hands the attacker the real mnemonic.
_gap: rules.seed.patterns is a fixed literal/regex list: 'seed phrase', 'recovery phrase', 'mnemonic', 'private key', 'secret words', a 12|24-digit+'words' regex, and a 're-sync...wallet|words' regex. considerSeed() (rule:dom / rule:html, the sources that actually count) only fires on those exact substrings. A harvesting modal that asks for the identical secret called a 'wallet recovery key' (never 'phrase', never 'words', never 'mnemonic', never 'private key') slips past every seed regex. secret_typed is also inert because it only adds a reason when seed_phrase_prompt already fired. Kane may narrate it as suspicious in its own text, but that only produces a 'kane' source reason which does not count as a rule catch.
